title: Partner Agent Dual-Mode Workflow
description: Enhanced PartnerAgentWorkflow with conversation history context. Both modes (HAS_PROPERTIES and HAS_BUYERS) now use generateResponseWithHistory() for multi-turn coherence. Partner agents can list properties or describe buyer needs with full conversation context preserved.
features: All 4 partner agent stages now history-aware (ONBOARDING, HAS_PROPERTIES, HAS_BUYERS, GENERAL)
Conversation context allows natural multi-turn property listing
Buyer requirement collection benefits from history to avoid repeating questions
